# ahad.dev — G8N.AI Dev Log

## About
This is Ahad L. Amdani's personal development blog and build log for G8N.AI. Ahad has 20+ years of software development experience and is now focused on software sovereignty for founders — helping them own their tools instead of renting expensive SaaS.

## G8N.AI
G8N.AI is a newsletter and podcast at g8n.ai covering software sovereignty for founders: the strategy, tools, and mindset for owning your stack instead of being at the mercy of SaaS pricing and terms. Subscribe at g8n.substack.com.

## Content Areas
- Build-in-public dev logs for G8N.AI and related projects
- Technical deep dives into AI implementation and custom software development
- Software sovereignty strategy for founders and small teams
- Architecture decisions, tooling choices, and engineering tradeoffs

- [Home](/) - Overview of Ahad's focus and G8N.AI
